inspection.document_shapes: Plans/ledger mappings, fixture checks/cleanup, contract timing series, sanitized plan nodes, schema/release digests, review notes. All43 parsed or text-reviewed; JSON arrays are aggregate observations, not application records.
inspection.private_artifacts: Relative private paths and SHA/byte references may be published; referenced files, native URLs, contents and screenshots remain excluded.
inspection.urls: Only noncredential official/reference/GitHub/Vercel metadata and localhost navigation URLs observed. No signed Storage/private object access URLs, query credentials or Auth tokens.

baseline_review.staging_catalog_vs_head: Nine additive indexes including Worker scope, plus sc_sizes executor SELECT ACL; no removed index.
baseline_review.staging_access_vs_head: Policies, column ACLs, function metadata/hashes, domain relations and Auth/outbox trigger metadata reflect reviewed114–141 migrations; schema metadata only.
baseline_review.functional_caveat: Publication approval does not replace current database catalog verification or final frozen refresh-worker revision update.

qr_source.intent: Original customer-facing payment recipient asset requested for source parity; no payment made.

limitations: Exact reviewed hashes only; changed or new files require another review.
This is publication privacy review, not acceptance of all workflows, production release approval or exclusive authorship.
Content indicators and structural review complement each other; secret scanning alone is not a universal PII detector.
The review receipt itself requires integrator inspection before final staging; its own hash cannot self-approve.
